spans.s:
r. 8th cl. (उ) ऋणु (अर्णोति or अर्णुते, ऋणोति or -णुते)
To go; according to some it is ऋन.

Debt.
2

A fort, a strong hold.
3 (In algebra,) Negative quantity, minus.
E.
ऋ to go, क्त affix, deriv. irr.

mfn. (-र्त्ता-र्त्त्री-र्त्तृ)
Getting into debt, indebted.
E.
ऋण and कर्त्तृ who makes.

mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं)
Indebted, involved in debt.
E.
ऋण and ग्रस्त seized.

Borrowing.
2

A borrower.
E.
ऋण and ग्र taking.

mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि)
Borrowing, a borrower.
E.
ऋण and ग्राहिन् who takes.

mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ)
One who pays a debt.
E.
ऋण and दातृ who gives. Also ऋणद (-दः-दा-दं) and ऋणदायिन् (-यी-यिनी-यि.)

n. (-नं)
Payment of debt.
E.
ऋण and दान giving.

n. (-नं)
Recovery of a debt, receipt of money, &c. lent It is one of the eighteen titles or subjects of judicial procedure.
E.
ऋण and आदान receiving.

m. (-णः)
A security, a bail.
E.
ऋण debt, मत्कुण an insect.

m. (-णः)
A security.
E.
ऋण, मृग to cleanse, in the causal, and ल्युट् aff.

f. (-क्तिः)
Discharge of a debt.
E.
ऋण and मुक्ति emancipation.

m. (-क्षः)
Paying a debt.
E.
ऋण and मोक्ष release.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Owing, in debt.
E.
ऋण and मतुप् aff.

n. (-नं)
Payment or discharge of a debt.
E.
ऋण an शोधन purifying.

m. (-कः)
The planet MARS.
E.
ऋण, अन्त end, and क affix of agency: being the patron of debtors.

n. (-नं)
Discharge of a debt.
E.
ऋण and अपनयन removing.

n. (-नं)
Payment of a debt.
E.
ऋण and अपनोदन removing.

n. (-णं)
Paying off a debt.
E.
ऋण and अपाकरण acquittance.
